question: Why do positive 100K PCQM architecture screens usually fail to retain a material gain at 500K?

alternative_explanations: low-data inductive-bias gains becoming redundant with more data

hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: Replace one-shot 100K promotion with a convergence- and transfer-aware gate before another 500K run.
